questions.question: If a + b + c = 4, ab + bc + ca = -14 and abc = -18, then the value of sqrt{4a³+4b³+4c³-36} will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 4

ab + bc + ca = -14

abc = -18

**Formula used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c) (a² + b² + c² – ab – bc – ca)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

 (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ a² + b² + c² = (4)² – 2 × (-14)

⇒ a2 + b2 + c² = 16 – (-28)

⇒ a² + b² + c² = (16 + 28) = 44

Now,

The value of √{4a³+4b³+4c³-36}

⇒ √4(a³ + b³ + c³) – 36

⇒ √4(a + b + c) (a2 + b2 + c2 – ab – bc – ca) + 3abc – 36

⇒ √4 × [4 × {44 – (-14) + 3 × (-18)}] – 36

⇒ √4 × [(4 × 58) – 54] – 36

⇒ √4 × (232 – 54) – 36

⇒ √(4 × 178) – 36

⇒ √712 – 36

⇒ √676

⇒ 26

**∴ The required value is 26 **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**√{4a³+4b³+4c³-36}

**⇒ √{4(a³+b³+c³)-36}**

⇒ √4(a + b + c)((a + b + c)2 - 3(ab + bc + ca)) + 3abc – 36

⇒ √4 × [4{4 × 4 - 3 × (-14)} + 3 × (-18)] - 36

⇒ √16(16 + 42) - 4 × 54 - 36

⇒ √928 - 216 - 36

⇒ √676

⇒ 26

∴ The required value is 26

questions.question: A shopkeeper charges Rs. 1.50 to photocopy a sheet of paper and a discount of 5.5% is given on all photocopies done after 400 sheets. How much will it cost to photocopy 800 sheets of paper?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total number of sheets = 800

A shopkeeper charges Rs. 1.50 to photocopy a sheet of paper

A discount of 5.5% is given on all photocopies done after 400 sheets

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Cost to photocopy next 400 sheets = Rs. (400 × 1.50) 

⇒ Rs. 600

Now,

Cost to photocopy after 400 sheets = [(400 × 1.50) × 94.5/100]

⇒ (600 × 94.5/100)

⇒ (6 × 94.5)

⇒ Rs. 567

Cost to photocopy 800 sheets of paper = Rs. (600 + 567)

⇒ Rs. 1,167

**∴ The required cost is Rs. 1,167**

questions.question: if the diameter of the base of a cone is 18 cm and its curved surface area is 424(2)/(7) cm², then its height will be: (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Radius** (r) = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm.

**Slant height** (l) = CSA ÷ (π × r) = (2970 / 7) ÷ (22 / 7 × 9) = 15 cm.

In a **cone**, height (h), radius (r), and slant height (l) form a **right-angled triangle**.

Using the **Pythagorean triplet** (9, 12, 15), where r = 9 and l = 15, the height must be 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Diameter** of the base = 18 cm

**Curved Surface Area** (CSA) = 424 2/7 cm²

**Formula Used:**

1. **Radius** (r) = Diameter ÷ 2

2. **Curved Surface Area** of a cone = πrl

3. **Slant height** (l)² = r² + h²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0be918285c9d2ec59e3e8d020b474df2d185a315f01eda13e769dd1fa0a67211.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Radius** (r) = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm

⇒ CSA = 424 2/7 = (424 × 7 + 2) ÷ 7 = 2970 / 7 cm²

⇒ π × r × l = 2970 / 7

⇒ (22 / 7) × 9 × l = 2970 / 7

⇒ 198 × l = 2970

⇒ l = 2970 ÷ 198 = 15 cm

⇒ **Height** (h) = √(l² − r²)

⇒ h = √(15² − 9²)

⇒ h = √(225 − 81)

⇒ h = √144

⇒ h = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The **Total Surface Area** of a cone is the sum of the curved area and the base area: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of a Cone

The **Volume** represents the capacity of the cone: V = 1/3 × πr²h.

Pythagorean Relationship

In any right circular cone, the relationship between **slant height**, **vertical height**, and **radius** is l² = h² + r².

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**</p

questions.question: If the perimeter of a circle is 88 cm, then what is the area of the circle? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of a circle = 88 cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of circle = 2πr

Area of the circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Perimeter of circle = 2πr

⇒ 2πr = 88

⇒ (2 × 22/7 × r) = 88

⇒ 44r/7 = 88

⇒ r = (7 × 2) cm

⇒ r = 14 cm

Now,

Area of circle = πr²

⇒ (22/7 × 14 × 14) cm²

⇒ (22 × 28) cm²

⇒ 616 cm²

**∴ The required area of the circle is 616 cm²**

questions.question: From a point P that is at a distance of 15 cm from centre O of a circle of radius 9 cm, in the same plane, a pair of tangents PQ and PR is drawn to the circle. The area of quadrilateral PQOR is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

From a point P that is at a distance of 15 cm from centre O of a circle of radius 9 cm

A pair of tangents PQ and PR is drawn to the circle

**Concept used:**

The tangent at any point of circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.

Tangents through an external point to a circle are equal.

(Base)2 + (Perpendicular)2 = (Hypotenuse)2

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3328c042b8d1142714469ea0528555c24d703af32e9f1952c9b47eac9d13fd1.png] 

Let P be a point at a distance of 15 cm from O.

Draw a pair of tangents, PQ and PR.

OQ = OR = radius = 9cm

And OP = 15 cm

We know that, tangent to at any point on the circle is perpendicular to the radius through point of contact.

Hence, we get

OQ ⏊ PQ and OR ⏊ PR

ΔPOQ and ΔPOR are right-angled triangles

Now,

Using Pythagoras theorem in ΔPQO

(Base)² + (Perpendicular)² = (Hypotenuse)²

⇒ (PQ)² + (OQ)² = (OP)²

⇒ (PQ)² + (9)² = (15)²

⇒ (PQ)² + 81 = 225

⇒ (PQ)² = (225 – 81)

⇒ (PQ)² = 144

⇒ PQ = 12 cm

Tangents through an external point to a circle are equal.

So,

 PQ = PR = 12 cm

Now,

The area of quadrilateral PQOR = Area of ΔPQO + Area of ΔPRO

⇒ (1/2 × OQ × PQ) + (1/2 × OR × PR)

⇒ (1/2 × 9 × 12) + (1/2 × 9 × 12)

⇒ (54 + 54) cm²

⇒ 108 cm²

**∴ The required value is 108 cm²**

questions.question: P and Q can complete a work in 9 days and 15 days, respectively. If they work together for three days, then in how many days will the remaining work be completed by Q alone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to complete a work by P = 9 days

Time taken to complete a work by Q = 15 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 9 and 15 is 45

Efficiency of P = (45/9) = 5 units/day

Efficiency of Q = (45/15) = 3 units/day

P and Q worked together for 3 days = [3 × (5 + 3)]

⇒ (3 × 8) = 24 units

Remaining work = (45 – 24) = 21 units

Now,

The remaining work completed by Q alone = (21/3)

⇒ 7 days

**∴ The required days is 7**

questions.question: If x⁸ – 2599x⁴ + 1 = 0, then the positive value of x-(1)/(x) will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x8 – 2599x4 + 1 = 0

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab

**Calculation:**

x8 – 2599x4 + 1 = 0

Dividing the equation by x⁴ we get,

⇒ x⁴ – 2599 + 1/x⁴ = 0

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 2599

As we know,

(x² + 1/x²)² = x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 × x² × 1/x²

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)2 = x4 + 1/x4 + 2

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)² = 2599 + 2

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)² = 2601

⇒ x² + 1/x² = √2601

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 51

Again as we know,

(x – 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² – 2 × x × 1/x

⇒ (x – 1/x)2 = x2 + 1/x2 – 2

⇒ (x – 1/x)² = 51 – 2

⇒ (x – 1/x)² = 49

⇒ (x – 1/x) = √49

⇒ x – 1/x = 7

**∴ The required value is 7**

questions.question: In how many years, the compound interest, if compounded annually on a sum of RS. 60,000 at rate of 8% per annum is Rs. 9,984?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interest for the 1st year = 8% of 60,000 = ₹4,800.

Interest for the 2nd year = 4,800 + (8% of 4,800) = 4,800 + 384 = ₹5,184.

Total **Compound Interest** for 2 years = 4,800 + 5,184 = ₹9,984.

Since the sum matches the given interest exactly, the **time period** is 2 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Principal (P)** = ₹60,000, **Rate (R)** = 8% per annum, **Compound Interest (CI)** = ₹9,984.

**Formula Used:** Amount (A) = P + CI and A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/342b6cf65431d0dec0158e32a9e7e0d98a7528cfb010283741de8ed5808b0128.png] 

⇒ **Amount (A)** = 60,000 + 9,984 = ₹69,984

⇒ 69,984 = 60,000 × (1 + 8/100)ⁿ

⇒ 69,984 / 60,000 = (108/100)ⁿ

⇒ 11,664 / 10,000 = (1.08)ⁿ

⇒ 1.1664 = (1.08)ⁿ

⇒ (1.08)² = (1.08)ⁿ

⇒ n = 2 years

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Interest Rate

For a rate R, the **effective rate** for 2 years in CI is given by (R + R + R×R/100)%. For 8%, it is 8 + 8 + 0.64 = 16.64%.

Difference between CI and SI

The difference between **Compound Interest** and **Simple Interest** for 2 years is P(R/100)².

Rule of 72

A quick way to estimate how long it takes for an investment to double: Time ≈ 72 ÷ Interest Rate.

questions.question: If (sin θ+cos θ)/(sin θ-cos θ)=3, then the value of sin⁴ θ - cos⁴ θ is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply **Componendo and Dividendo**: (sin θ + cos θ + sin θ − cos θ) ÷ (sin θ + cos θ − (sin θ − cos θ)) = (3 + 1) ÷ (3 − 1).

⇒ 2 sin θ ÷ 2 cos θ = 4 ÷ 2 ⇒ tan θ = 2.

Using **Right Triangle**: perpendicular = 2, base = 1, hypotenuse = √(2² + 1²) = √5.

sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ − cos² θ)(sin² θ + cos² θ) = sin² θ − cos² θ = (2/√5)² − (1/√5)² = 4/5 − 1/5 = 3/5.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e53016cf20d48ff2b11e61d6da24b5d88e3e89c416deaaef04756799ac91fdfe.png] 

**Given:** (sin θ + cos θ) / (sin θ − cos θ) = 3

**Formula Used:** sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ + cos² θ)(sin² θ − cos² θ); sin² θ + cos² θ = 1

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = 3(sin θ − cos θ)

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = 3 sin θ − 3 cos θ

⇒ 4 cos θ = 2 sin θ

⇒ tan θ = 2

⇒ sin θ = 2/√5 and cos θ = 1/√5

⇒ sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ − cos² θ)(1)

⇒ (2/√5)² − (1/√5)² = 4/5 − 1/5 = 3/5

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identities include sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ, and 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Algebraic Difference of Powers

For even powers, a⁴ − b⁴ can be factored into (a² − b²)(a² + b²), which is very useful in trigonometric simplifications.

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

If a/b = c/d, then (a+b)/(a-b) = (c+d)/(c-d). This rule simplifies ratio-based trigonometric equations quickly.</p

Speed of man = 4 km/h

Time taken by man = 18 min

Speed = Distance/Time

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/s

1 min = 60 sec

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be x

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ (4 × 5/18) = x/(18 × 60)

⇒ 20/18 = x/1080

⇒ 18x = 1080 × 20

⇒ 18x = 21,600

⇒ x = (21,600/18)

⇒ 1200 m

**∴ The length of the tunnel is 1200 m**

questions.question: The length of the base of a triangle is 3 cm smaller than the length of its altitude. Its area is 104 cm². What is the length of the base?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of the base of a triangle = 3 cm smaller than the length of its altitude

Area of triangle = 104 cm²

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the base of the triangle be x cm.

The length of the base of a triangle is 3 cm smaller than the length of its altitude = (x + 3)

Now,

Area of triangle = [1/2 × x × (x + 3)] = 104

⇒ (1/2 × x² + 3x) = 104

⇒ x² + 3x = 208

⇒ x² + 3x – 208 = 0

⇒ x² + 16x – 13x – 208 = 0

⇒ x(x + 16) – 13(x + 16) = 0

⇒ (x – 13) (x + 16) = 0

⇒ x = 13, -16

Now,

The length of base of the triangle = x = 13 cm

**∴ The required value is 13 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Area of triangle = [1/2 × x × (x + 3)] = 104

⇒ x × ( x + 3) = 208

⇒ x × (x + 3) = 13 × 16

⇒ x × (x + 3) = 13 × (13 +3)

On comparing x = 13

The length of base of the triangle = x = 13 cm

∴ The required value is 13 cm

questions.question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/919beb05200ec0853c10ba1d6ede51708cac79dc6da7d592da2b3a6c11a8a28e.png] 

Which class has the highest percentage of failed students?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of boys and girls in class A = (27 + 31) = 58

Number of students promoted in class A = 43

Number of failed students in class A = [(58 – 43)/58 × 100] 

⇒ (15/58 × 100)

⇒ (1500/58)

⇒ 25.86%

Now,

Total number of boys and girls in class B = (35 + 30) = 65

Number of students promoted in class B = 45

Number of failed students in class B = [(65 – 45)/65 × 100] 

⇒ (20/65 × 100)

⇒ (2000/65)

⇒ 30.77%

Now,

Total number of boys and girls in class C = (30 + 32) = 62

Number of students promoted in class C = 58

Number of failed students in class C = [(62 – 58)/62 × 100] 

⇒ (4/62 × 100)

⇒ (400/62)

⇒ 6.45%

Now,

Total number of boys and girls in class D = (33 + 34) = 67

Number of students promoted in class D = 61

Number of failed students in class D = [(67 – 61)/67 × 100]

⇒ (6/67 × 100)

⇒ (600/67)

⇒ 8.96%

**∴ The highest percentage of failed students in class B **
